name: @buspass/backend
description: Backend for BusTech Passenger Assistance System

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/*.integration.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/assistanceRequestService.test.js dist/tests/aviator.test.js dist/tests/journey.test.js dist/tests/location.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="dist/**/*.js" --test-coverage-exclude="dist/tests/**" --test-coverage-exclude="dist/server.js" --test-coverage-exclude="dist/cli/**" dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/*.integration.test.js
